answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance grows like a coral reef: each identity must accrete verified attestation history on-chain over time, and a freshly forged agent cannot echo a long track record it never earned. To forge N identities an attacker must fund N separate bonds and then wait out the maturation canyon, the deep gap between a brand-new key and a trusted one, since untrusted keys carry near-zero grading weight. Any attestation proven false slashes that bond, so the cost scales linearly in both capital and elapsed time with no shortcut across the canyon.
